dense.activation_audit: one decision per fresh collection; repeated per-inner metrics must not be counted as new groups
dense.cost: mean(1-NC,1-DAC,1-TTC); indicator deficit, not accident severity
dense.dense_cost: d_i=mean(flags_i[1:41]); fraction of failed offroad time, not geometric margin
dense.dense_delta: mean(d)-d, offset-centered FP64; add to A_safe and A_raw, keep A_EP
dense.eligibility: all G NC=TTC=1,DAC=0; original Safety raw A exactly zero; all t0 drivable; real Gx41 binary fields; duration differs
dense.extra_material: eligible real flags/duration/delta saved; ineligible explicitly None; missing is not zero
dense.initial_legal_gate: all flags[:,0] == false; initially-invalid groups unchanged
dense.inner_updates: reuse same detached advantages for all four updates
dense.interpretation: positive A is failed least-cost guidance, never a verified successful trajectory
dense.loss: unchanged source rank mean PPO, cap5, beta50 permanent IL70 physical mean anchor
dense.mask: all-zero raw group has zero PG mask, successful saturation is not failure
dense.normalization: original Safety raw-A population std over world*G +1e-8; only exact zero uses updated raw-A global std
dense.other_groups: original normalized advantages bit-exact when original global std >0; no global renormalization
dense.safety_advantage: if any feasible: f-mean(f); else: mean(c)-c

inversion.activation_audit: one decision per fresh collection; native metrics repeat for four inner uses
inversion.canonical_numeric: quality gate uses original FP64 official score, not rounded FP32 rollout reward
inversion.cost: mean(1-NC,1-DAC,1-TTC); indicator deficit, not accident severity
inversion.delta: deterministic pair transfer min(-A_high,A_lower); high increases, lower decreases; add delta to EP only; use returned updated_rawA
inversion.eligibility: strict4 canonical>=.9 originalnegative endpoint, and strictly feasible lower-canonical originalpositive endpoint
inversion.exclusivity: mutually exclusive with Protected/Saturated/DenseDAC; separate independently registered schema
inversion.group_mean: original group sum conserved in real arithmetic; FP64 roundoff recorded, never recentered
inversion.high_quality: strict four metric passes with canonical score>=.9; not a new positive advantage
inversion.inner_updates: reuse same detached advantages for all four updates
inversion.loss: unchanged source rank mean PPO, cap5, beta50 permanent IL70 physical mean anchor
inversion.mask: original mask retained even when all updated rawA become0; new truePG0 counted explicitly
inversion.normalization: original world*G Safety rawA std +1e-8 strictly retained; no recenter, no fallback, no new global normalization
inversion.order: negative endpoints score descending/index ascending; positive endpoints score ascending/index ascending
inversion.original_sign: gate uses stored actual original FP64 rawA; CPU recovery validates it within1e-14 before reusing its exact sign
inversion.preserved: unchanged candidates raw/normalizedA bitexact; same original world*G scale; original entire group mask retained
inversion.retention_limit: no negative self-credit on this candidate; shared parameters, anchor and other states may still harm it
inversion.safety_advantage: if any feasible: f-mean(f); else: mean(c)-c
inversion.sign_relation: custom canonical-dominance sign cancellation, not Sign/GRPO theorem replication
inversion.unmatched: high negatives remain if no lower-score positive mass remains; no fabricated witness/positive advantage

saturated.activation_audit: one fresh collection is one decision; per-inner metrics reuse the same material
saturated.canonical_numeric: unchanged original FP32 canonical reward labels promoted to FP64 for offset-centering
saturated.cost: mean(1-NC,1-DAC,1-TTC); indicator deficit, not accident severity
saturated.delta: deltaA=R-mean(R), FP64 offset-centered; A_safe unchanged; add to A_EP and A_raw only in eligible groups
saturated.eligibility: all G NC=DAC=TTC=EP exactly1; original Safety rawA exactly0; saved canonical R nonconstant
saturated.exclusivity: cannot combine DenseDAC and success-saturation credit in the same runtime
saturated.extra_material: saturated_credit status/eligibility/delta/digest persisted and recomputed on native recovery
saturated.high_quality: diagnostic strict NC/DAC/TTC/Comfort1 and canonicalscore>=.9, not a new eligibility gate
saturated.inner_updates: reuse same detached advantages for all four updates
saturated.loss: unchanged source rank mean PPO, cap5, beta50 permanent IL70 physical mean anchor
saturated.mask: all-zero raw group has zero PG mask, successful saturation is not failure
saturated.normalization: original Safety world*G rawA population std +1e-8; only exactzero uses updated world*G rawA std
saturated.other_groups: baseline normalized advantages and mask bitexact when baselineStd>0
saturated.safety_advantage: if any feasible: f-mean(f); else: mean(c)-c
saturated.safety_labels: original strict-feasible labels unchanged; failed groups never become eligible

cost: mean(1-NC,1-DAC,1-TTC); indicator deficit, not accident severity
disjointness: Dense allfailedDAConly originalA0; Sat allfeasibleEP1 originalA0; inversion originalA nonzero with qualifying opposite signs
exclusions: No endpoint joint loss, reward transform, resampling, teacher, extra actor observation or independent protected gate

ordering: Evaluate every eligibility against ORIGINAL Safety rawA and canonical feedback; assert <=1 activated branch per scene
